messages:
Alex Rivera: Quick notefound a mismatch in the JS quickstart. README shows `import Redwood from 'redwood'` but the package now exports `RedwoodClient`. New users get `TypeError: Redwood is not a constructor` when they copy paste.

Priya Singh: Ugh. I also saw the example uses `Authorization: Token ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}` in the curl snippet, but the service expects `Bearer` and env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Those 2 differences together make the quickstart a frustrating first impression.

Jordan Lee: Saw a CI failure in the sample-app tests yesterday from the same issue. The sample-app's retry wrapper also replays requests on 5xx even though the SDK already retries idempotent calls; results in duplicate side effects for some POST endpoints.

Alex Rivera: Proposed changes: update import to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'`, switch all examples to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, and remove manual retry wrapper from sample app. Add a short note: "If you have a custom retry strategy, disable the SDK retries by passing { retries: 0 } to the client."

Priya Singh: Also include a tiny TS example showing named import and constructor options so TS users don't hit typing errors. Something like:
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, retries: 3 });
const out = await client.generate('Summarize this...');
```

Jordan Lee: +1. Add a note about fetch/curl header format to avoid permission errors: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and mention scope mismatches ("generation" vs "embeddings").

Alex Rivera: I created a small PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/3002 with the import fix, env var parity, TS snippet, and removal of the retry wrapper. Requesting review.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Label `docs:dx` added; reviewers requested: @priya, @jordan.

Priya Singh: Reviewed and left one tiny nit on wording for the TS example comments.

Jordan Lee: Approved.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: docs updated at https://docs.redwood.ai/js-quickstart version 2026-03-22T18:12Z :rocket:

Alex Rivera: Closing. I'll sweep other language quickstarts next sprint for similar export/name drift. Thanks team :+1:
